description.p: PowerSifu is a small Linux tray utility for switching power profiles when the charger changes, applying per-profile screen brightness and recurring schedules, checking for updates, and stopping selected applications.
Application rules use exact process-name matching, target only processes owned by the current user, and protect critical desktop services.
Keep GNOME's Quick Settings brightness slider synchronized with profile changes.
Show the active profile and preview profile brightness immediately.
Install verified official updates from the app with system authentication.
Add a permission-safe GNOME fallback for display brightness changes.
Fix a settings-window startup crash caused by a GTK widget name collision.
Launch PowerSifu as a standalone desktop process without keeping a terminal attached.
Adds profile-aware display brightness and an opt-in update checker.
Initial release with tray controls, source switching, schedules, and application rules.
